preferences.name: zen-page-skip.next-shortcut
preferences.title: Next page shortcut
preferences.description: Key combination used to go to the next page. Examples: Alt+], Ctrl+Alt+Right, Alt+N.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.previous-shortcut
preferences.title: Previous page shortcut
preferences.description: Key combination used to go to the previous page. Examples: Alt+[, Ctrl+Alt+Left, Alt+P.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.disabled-sites
preferences.title: Disabled sites
preferences.description: Comma- or newline-separated hostnames. Use *.example.com to disable subdomains without disabling example.com itself.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.cooldown-ms
preferences.title: Shortcut cooldown (milliseconds)
preferences.description: Minimum time between shortcut actions. Values from 0 to 5000 are accepted; default is 400.
